small_company.title: Small company - Companies Act s.2(85) read with Rule 2(1)(t)
small_company.explain: A private company (not holding/subsidiary, not s.8, not under a special Act) is 'small' if paid-up capital and turnover (preceding FY) are both within the limits. Small companies are exempt from CARO, cash flow statement, and get lighter AS/Sch III disclosure.

caro_private_exempt.title: CARO - private company exemption (all three limits together)
caro_private_exempt.explain: A private company that is not a holding/subsidiary of a public company is outside CARO only if paid-up capital + reserves <= 1 cr at balance sheet date, bank/FI borrowings <= 1 cr at ANY time in the year, and total revenue (incl. other income) <= 10 cr.

caro_regime.title: Which Companies (Auditor's Report) Order applies to the financial year
caro_regime.explain: Selected by the financial year START date. CARO 2020 applies to financial years commencing on/after 1 April 2020 (the 2019-20 effective date was deferred), so FY 2019-20 is still reported under CARO 2016.

rule11_funds.title: Rule 11(e) - funds advanced / received through intermediaries
rule11_funds.explain: Management-representation reporting on intermediaries and funding parties. Applies to audit reports for FY starting on/after 1 April 2021.

rule11_dividend.title: Rule 11(f) - dividend declared or paid
rule11_dividend.explain: Report whether dividend declared/paid complies with s.123. Applies from FY starting on/after 1 April 2021.

rule11_audit_trail.title: Rule 11(g) - accounting software with audit trail (edit log)
rule11_audit_trail.explain: Mandatory from FY starting on/after 1 April 2023. From FY 2024-25 the report must also say the audit trail was preserved as per statutory record retention.
rule11_audit_trail.source: Companies (Accounts) Second Amendment Rules 2021 / Rule 3(1) as amended 2022; Rule 11(g)

ifc_exempt.title: s.143(3)(i) - exemption from IFC-over-financial-reporting opinion
ifc_exempt.explain: Private company is exempt if turnover < 50 cr in the previous year AND borrowings from banks/FIs < 25 cr at any time in the year (also exempt: OPC, small company).

cash_flow_exempt.title: Cash flow statement - who is exempt
cash_flow_exempt.explain: Financial statement as defined in s.2(40) does not include a cash flow statement for One Person Company, small company and dormant company.

cash_limits.title: Cash transaction limits used by the checkers
cash_limits.explain: Rs 10,000 cash payment per day per person (s.40A(3) - disallowance; Rs 35,000 for transporters); Rs 20,000 cash loan/deposit/repayment (s.269SS/269T); Rs 2,00,000 cash receipt (s.269ST). The Income-tax Act 2025 carries corresponding provisions - section numbers may differ.
cash_limits.source: Income-tax law - CA to confirm for the current year

going_concern.title: Going-concern indicators used by the checkers
going_concern.explain: Net worth negative or accumulated losses >= net worth, continuing losses with nil revenue, dependence on director loans. SA 570 requires evaluating management's plan; a material uncertainty needs a separate paragraph in the report.
